set -u
B=http://127.0.0.1:8123
echo "--- GET / (head) ---"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code} type=%{content_type} size=%{size_download}\n' $B/
echo "--- GET stats (empty) ---"
curl -sS -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' $B/api/stats
echo "--- GET list (empty) ---"
curl -sS -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' "$B/api/tasks"
echo "--- POST create high todo ---"
curl -sS -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' -X POST $B/api/tasks -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"  写周报  ","description":"整理本周进展","priority":"high","due_date":"2026-10-01"}'
echo "--- POST create medium no due ---"
curl -sS -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' -X POST $B/api/tasks -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"买牛奶_100%","description":"超市 A_B"}'
echo "--- POST create done low due future ---"
curl -sS -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' -X POST $B/api/tasks -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"已完成的活","status":"done","priority":"low","due_date":"2030-01-01"}'

echo '--- static css/js ---'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'styles status=%{http_code} type=%{content_type}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8123/styles.css
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'app.js status=%{http_code} type=%{content_type}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8123/app.js
echo '--- traversal attempts ---'
for p in '/../requirements.md' '/..%2frequirements.md' '/%2e%2e/README.md' '/static/../../../etc/passwd' '/../taskboard/store.py'; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --path-as-is "http://127.0.0.1:8123$p"); echo "$p -> $code"
done
echo '--- CSP header ---'
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8123/ | tr -d '\r' | grep -i -E 'content-security|x-content-type'
echo '--- 405 wrong method ---'
curl -sS -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:8123/api/tasks/1 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"x"}'

python3 - <<'PY'
import socket
paths = ["/styles.css", "/app.js", "/../requirements.md", "/..%2frequirements.md",
         "/%2e%2e/README.md", "/static/../taskboard/store.py", "/../taskboard/store.py",
         "/static/..%2f..%2frequirements.md"]
for p in paths:
    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8123), timeout=5)
    s.sendall(f"GET {p} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n".encode())
    data = b""
    while True:
        chunk = s.recv(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
    s.close()
    head, _, body = data.partition(b"\r\n\r\n")
    status = head.split(b"\r\n")[0].decode()
    ctype = [l.decode() for l in head.split(b"\r\n") if l.lower().startswith(b"content-type")]
    leaked = b"TaskBoard" in body and p != "/styles.css" and p != "/app.js"
    print(f"{p} -> {status} {ctype} bytes={len(body)} contains_source_marker={leaked}")
